_about: Fun facts and jokes about something or someone: "fun fact about axolotls", "tell me a joke about Katter", "make fun of Katter". Read by the Discord bot (personality.topic_request) and the mod (MerlLines.topicRequest), on normalized text (lower case, no punctuation or apostrophes). A pattern must match the whole text; the subject is in the group named subject.
fact: (.* )?(fun |cool |random |interesting |weird |crazy |surprising |little |good |nice |new )*(facts?|funfacts?|trivia|something (interesting|fun|cool|new|weird)|interesting things?|cool things?|fun things?)( you know)? (about|on|regarding|of|with|for) (?<subject>.+?)( please| pls| plz| merl)?
joke: (.* )?(funny |silly |good |bad |dad |cheesy |little |nice |new )*(jokes?|puns?)( you know)? (about|on|with|for|of) (?<subject>.+?)( please| pls| plz| merl)?
(.* )?(make fun of|roast|tease|poke fun at|joke about|laugh at) (?<subject>.+?)( a (bit|little))?( please| pls| plz| merl)?
(.* )?(say|tell me|tell us) something funny about (?<subject>.+?)( please| pls| plz| merl)?
